agent_note: Quotation marks appear to be absent from this book's dialogue entirely -- every speech quote here relies on speech tags ('she says'), direct address, tag questions and register rather than marks. Two distinct strands are visible in the quote text: a present-tense close-third strand around a male character ('He wonders', 'he is unremarkable', 'Today it strikes Bird'), and a past-tense first-person address strand from a woman to a child ('Why did I tell you so many stories?', 'When you were born, your father wanted you to have my name'), plus past-tense retrospective summary. The past minority is therefore structural (an embedded address/recollection strand), not noise.
